description: TX11 (D-070, docs/units/TX11/plan.md): after the known-base-defect step, a failing test of gate-flake.stages that the PR did not touch is re-run once at the same head; one that passes is attributed flake (recorded, shown, quarantined on its second sighting) and does not turn the PR red. Off is the rollback: no re-run, every failure stays the PR's.
